title: VASP harmonic phonons
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-phonons workflow: it computes the harmonic phonons of a crystal structure with VASP and phonopy, from an optional tight relaxation, its HPKOT primitive cell and one single point per displaced supercell, giving the force constants, the phonon band structure along the HPKOT path, the phonon density of states and the harmonic thermodynamics, with an optional non-analytical correction.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure whose phonons are computed.
Output role relaxed_structure is a structures entry containing the tightly relaxed structure (only with relax = true); output role phonon_cell is a structures entry containing the HPKOT primitive cell whose dynamical matrix phonopy diagonalized, to which the phonon records refer; output role phonon_band_structure is a records entry containing the phonon frequencies of the phonon cell along the HPKOT q-point path, in THz; output role phonon_density_of_states is a records entry containing the phonon density of states of the phonon cell, in modes per THz per cell; output role vibrational_thermodynamics is a records entry containing the harmonic vibrational free energy, internal energy, entropy and heat capacity of the phonon cell versus temperature; output role zero_point_energy is a records entry containing the vibrational zero-point energy of the phonon cell, in eV; output role phonons_result is a files entry containing phonons.json, every input of the phonon analysis and its results; output role phonopy_disp is a files entry containing phonopy_disp.yaml, phonopy's unit cell, supercell matrix and displacements; and output role force_sets is a files entry containing FORCE_SETS, phonopy's displacements with the forces of each displaced supercell.

inputs.name: initial_structure
inputs.description: The structure whose phonons are computed.

outputs.name: relaxed_structure
outputs.description: The tightly relaxed structure (only with relax = true).

outputs.name: phonon_cell
outputs.description: The HPKOT primitive cell whose dynamical matrix phonopy diagonalized; the phonon records refer to it.

outputs.name: phonon_band_structure
outputs.description: The phonon frequencies of the phonon cell along the HPKOT q-point path, in THz.

outputs.name: phonon_density_of_states
outputs.description: The phonon density of states of the phonon cell, in modes per THz per cell.

outputs.name: vibrational_thermodynamics
outputs.description: The harmonic vibrational free energy, internal energy, entropy and heat capacity of the phonon cell versus temperature.

outputs.name: zero_point_energy
outputs.description: The vibrational zero-point energy of the phonon cell, in eV.

outputs.name: phonons_result
outputs.description: phonons.json: every input of the phonon analysis (the forces and settings of each displacement, the supercell, the non-analytical correction) and its results.

outputs.name: phonopy_disp
outputs.description: phonopy_disp.yaml: phonopy's unit cell, supercell matrix and displacements.

outputs.name: force_sets
outputs.description: FORCE_SETS: phonopy's displacements with the forces of each displaced supercell.
